name: plugin-zod
description: Generates Zod v4 schemas from your OpenAPI spec so you validate API responses, form input, and query params at runtime.

options.label: Barrel
options.description: How index.ts barrel files are generated

options.label: Output Mode
options.description: How the plugin consolidates its code into files. File mode writes everything into a single file, so the output path must include a file extension and cannot be grouped.

options.label: Group
options.description: Group generated operations by OpenAPI tag or path

options.label: Exclude Tags
options.description: Comma-separated OpenAPI tags to exclude from generation

options.label: Include Tags
options.description: Comma-separated OpenAPI tags to include. Only operations with these tags are generated

options.label: Zod Mini
options.description: Use Zod Mini functional API for better tree-shaking

options.label: Import Path
options.description: Module specifier used in the import statement

options.label: GUID Type
options.description: Validator used for OpenAPI format: uuid

options.label: Regex Type
options.description: Output form for an OpenAPI pattern inside .regex(...)

options.label: oneOf Type
options.description: How a oneOf is validated: z.union with strict object members, or z.xor (Zod v4.2.0+)

options.label: Inferred
options.description: Export a z.infer type alias next to every generated schema

options.label: Coercion
options.description: Wrap schemas in z.coerce so input is coerced before validation

options.label: Compile
options.description: Wrap schemas with z.compile(...) for faster validation. Needs Zod 4.5 or later

options.label: Type Guards
options.description: Generate is* type guards and assert* functions for each schema. Needs Zod 4.6 or later

options.label: Banner
options.description: Text added at the top of every generated file

options.label: Footer
options.description: Text added at the end of every generated file
